عللت (form I)
# عَلَلْتُ (ʕalaltu) /ʕa.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَلَّ (ʕalla)
# عَلَلْتَ (ʕalalta) /ʕa.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَلَّ (ʕalla)
# عَلَلْتِ (ʕalalti) /ʕa.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَلَّ (ʕalla)
# عُلِلْتُ (ʕuliltu) /ʕu.lil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of عَلَّ (ʕalla)
# عُلِلْتَ (ʕulilta) /ʕu
